children.description: TinyRL monitor state (retained): state=idle|learn|ok|alarm, condition_id (unknown = open ask for a label), confidence 0..1, episode_s, batch = the ask's stored batch id (present ONLY while the ask is live), kind = the labeled library kind normal|fault (present ONLY when condition_id names a labeled condition; absent for idle/learning/unknown/unlabeled).

extendProperties.cadence: on state or condition_id change + on (re)connect
